title: Routine Drift Before Bad Days
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifescore:daily
| search routine_drift_pct=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(routine_drift_pct) as avg_routine_drift_pct by _time bad_day_next
| sort - _time
description: Tracks routine drift before bad days over time and breaks it out by next-day bad flag.
value: Drift before bad days is where prevention becomes possible instead of just post-mortem analysis.
implementation: Send routine drift before bad days events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of routine drift before bad days by next-day bad flag.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how routine drift before bad days changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
